The quiz is at `quizzes/0002.json` and its key is at `keys/0002.json`. It has 6 items, all multiple choice, all on O4. I didn't run a JSON parse check, because the shell blocked that command. I did answer each item from its stem alone, without the key.

The quiz is ahead of the lessons: there is no O4 lesson yet, so I built it from the objective's wording and your makerspace assistant. It covers:
- who owns the control flow
- classifying a fixed pipeline and an open-ended request
- when a fixed workflow is the better choice
- how to answer "make everything an agent" at the design review

You can take it here in the chat, or hand in your answers to be graded.
